dct_description_sm: Togo administrative level 0-3 edge-matched gazetteer, shapefiles, geodatabase, and geoservice. COD-EM datasets do not replace the authoritative [COD-AB available here](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-tgo); however COD-EM datasets may be preferred for cartographic purposes. See caveats. These layers are suitable for database or GIS linkage to the [Togo - Subnational Population Statistics](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ps-tgo) tables. Vetting by Information Technology Outreach Services (ITOS) with funding from USAID.
dct_publisher_sm: Global Administrative Unit Layers (GAUL) and ITOS
